name: Perfect match
description: PO and invoice agree on every field.

name: Quantity mismatch
description: Invoice quantity differs from the PO.
note: Targeted at the quantity comparison rule.

name: Unit-price mismatch
description: Invoice unit price differs from the PO.
note: Targeted at the unit-price comparison rule.

name: Total mismatch
description: Invoice grand total differs from the PO.
note: Targeted at the total comparison rule.

name: Vendor mismatch
note: Targeted at the vendor comparison rule.

name: PO-number mismatch
description: Invoice references a different PO number.
note: Targeted at the PO-number comparison rule.

name: Missing required field
description: Invoice does not include a PO reference.

name: Multiple line items
note: Exercises item pairing across multiple rows.

name: Formatting variation
description: Vendor whitespace/case and thousand separators differ between documents.
note: Exercises the conservative normalizer (should still MATCH).

name: Invalid/unreadable document
description: Invoice is a scanned/image-only PDF (no text layer).
note: Expected: INVALID DOCUMENT with a clear scanned-PDF message.
